topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: When my neighbor approached me with the idea of using a portion of my yard for a garden, I found myself hesitating, my mind filling with scenarios of what could go wrong. What if the garden spreads beyond the agreed space? What if it attracts pests or damages my property? I nodded, trying to sound supportive, but my voice came out a bit shaky. I told myself it’s just a garden, nothing more, but the idea of ceding control over my space to someone else, even a trusted neighbor, made my palms sweat. I agreed, but I couldn’t shake the uneasy feeling that lingered long after our conversation.
